conditions.blue: First candidate; failed strict B01 distinction

model: All executor agents inherited the same parent model/settings. Exact runtime model identifier and revision were not exposed.
protocol: See PROTOCOL-ADDENDUM.md. B01 user turns delivered sequentially; B02-B09 share one executor context within each condition; single-run synthetic fixtures. Grading is independent but not fully blinded.
activation: Metadata-only model routing probe, not native host activation. Discovery metadata unchanged between blue and green, so the same probe applies.
public_record_transform: Actual output files are copied with local task/runtime paths replaced by {{RUN_ROOT}} and {{SKILL_FORGE_DIR}}. Inputs and criteria remain unchanged. No private interview transcript is included.
comparison_limits: One matched baseline execution and one execution per candidate. No statistical or broad model/host performance claim; original known cases are regressions for candidate2. H01 was authored after candidate2 freeze and not available to the candidate author at patch time.
